# U.S. Masters Swimming

> U.S. Masters Swimming (USMS) is the national organization for adult competitive swimming, providing clubs, events, training resources, and community for swimmers of all levels.

USMS serves as the governing body for masters swimming in the United States, offering membership benefits, competitive opportunities, and educational content through its network of local clubs and national championships. The organization publishes SWIMMER magazine and maintains partnerships with USA Swimming Foundation and other swimming organizations.

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://www.usms.org): Main entry point offering clubs, events, workouts, and community for adult swimmers
- [What is U.S. Masters Swimming?](https://www.usms.org/about/what-is-us-masters-swimming): Overview of USMS organization, mission, and membership benefits
- [Join or Renew with USMS](https://www.usms.org/join-usms/join-or-renew): Membership registration and renewal page with pricing and benefits
- [My Account Log in](https://www.usms.org/myusmslogin): User authentication and account login portal for USMS members

## Find Clubs & Events

- [USMS Club Finder](https://www.usms.org/clubs): Searchable directory of adult swimming clubs across the United States
- [Calendar of Swimming Events](https://www.usms.org/events): Calendar of upcoming pool, open water, and virtual swimming events

## Training & Fitness

- [Swim Workout Library](https://www.usms.org/workout-library): Searchable library of swimming workouts for all ability levels
- [Articles and Videos](https://www.usms.org/fitness-and-training/articles-and-videos): Collection of swimming training articles and instructional videos
- [Learn to Swim Freestyle With This Drill Progression](https://www.usms.org/fitness-and-training/articles-and-videos/videos/learn-to-swim-freestyle-with-this-drill-progression): Video tutorial on freestyle technique drills and progression
- [Swimming Turns: The Complete Guide](https://www.usms.org/turns): Comprehensive guide to flip turns, open turns, and relay transitions
- [Four Exercises to Alleviate Hip Pain](https://www.usms.org/fitness-and-training/articles-and-videos/articles/four-exercises-to-alleviate-hip-pain): Members-only article on hip pain relief exercises for swimmers
- [Is Your Mid-Back Causing Your Shoulder Pain When Swimming](https://www.usms.org/fitness-and-training/articles-and-videos/articles/is-your-mid-back-causing-your-shoulder-pain-when-swimming): Members-only article on mid-back and shoulder pain in swimming

## Organization & Leadership

- [Mission Vision Values](https://www.usms.org/about/mission-vision-values): USMS mission statement, vision, and organizational values
- [Board of Directors](https://www.usms.org/volunteer-central/board-and-committees/board-of-directors): USMS board of directors and organizational governance structure
- [National Office](https://www.usms.org/about/national-office): USMS national office staff directory and contact information

## Volunteer & Community

- [Club and Event Grant Information](https://www.usms.org/volunteer-central/guide-to-local-operations/club-and-event-development-programs): Information on club and event grants and development funding programs

- [How Far Is a Mile in Swimming Actually?](https://www.usms.org/fitness-and-training/articles-and-videos/articles/how-far-is-a-mile-in-swimming-actually): Article explaining different mile measurements in swimming contexts
- [Ellen Reynolds to Be Inducted to MISHOF in 2026](https://www.usms.org/fitness-and-training/articles-and-videos/articles/ellen-reynolds-to-be-inducted-to-mishof-in-2026): News article about Ellen Reynolds' hall of fame induction
